# Run mypy on all Python files in src/ with relaxed settings

    --disable-error-code attr-defined \
    --disable-error-code return-value \

    --disable-error-code arg-type \
    --disable-error-code type-arg \
    --disable-error-code union-attr \
    --disable-error-code no-untyped-def \
    --disable-error-code no-untyped-call \
    --disable-error-code var-annotated \
    --disable-error-code exit-return \
    --disable-error-code assignment \
    --disable-error-code index \
    --ignore-missing-imports 2>&1

# If mypy fails (non-zero exit code), block the commit
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Type checking failed. Please fix the mypy errors before committing."
    exit 1
fi
